comment: Limits for tests/perf/run-resource-audit.py on the router emulator: processes (execs) and file operations on USB (opt_ops) per run; daemons per minute at one DNS query per second (a short window sees more first-time names, which are logged). Measured values of 0.2.0-rc.2 (resource contour: shell builtins, one clock read, lighter admission) plus headroom (daemons vary with the names seen in the window; the supervisor may log one event, such as PANEL_START_FAILED, inside it). fix.33.2: jobs by the median of 5 runs with crond paused, daemons by the quieter of two windows; medians of 5 runs, two audits each (2026-10-24): updater check 57 and 60 on dev, 59 and 59 on fix.33.2; housekeeping 25 and 25 on dev, 25 and 26 on fix.33.2 (no growth beyond the run-to-run spread); limits are the branch median plus 2 (owner: at most plus 1-2).
